title: Prefix-scan advancement label
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $m$ be one of the four code modes (valid, initial, accepting, or step-pair), let $p\in\{0,1,2\}$ and $k\in\{0,1,2,3\}$, and let $i$ be a natural number. If $i=0$, the label is the advancement label indexed by $p$ and $k$; if $i>0$, it is the continuation label determined by $m$, $p$, and $k$.
